articles.title: Telegram faces terror-related legal action in Australia one day after founder is charged by Russia
articles.snippet: The platform faces a fine of up to $38 million for allegedly failing to remove terror-related content.

articles.title: Bitcoin and ether markets are ruled by perps. SpaceX showed how far their influence can go
articles.snippet: Perpetual futures drive much of the price discovery for bitcoin and ether. When traders pointed the same machinery at a private company, they priced the biggest IPO in history more accurately than Wall Street, and then watched the stock walk away from them.

articles.title: Australia sues Telegram over alleged failures to remove terror content
articles.snippet: Telegram faces Australian court proceedings after eSafety alleged the platform failed to detect and remove extremist material shared by users.

articles.title: Your 'Sexual Wellness' Pills Order Info From Hims Got Shared With Meta, Says FTC
articles.snippet: Regulators accuse the telehealth company of sharing sensitive health information with advertising platforms including Meta and Snap despite promising users privacy.

articles.title: Australia Sues Telegram for $38M Over ‘Pro-Terror’ Videos
articles.snippet: The eSafety Commissioner accused the social media platform of failing to detect material relating to the Christchurch and Buffalo attacks.
